prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, reorder] Story Companion Intro Flow Shift: Reorders the opening experience so the story screen introduces pet types in a full-bleed split view before path selection. (why: choose_path step has high mean time (514s) and 20.9% drop-off, indicating users need context before choosing a path.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Safety Hint: Displays a prominent sync hint explaining that logging into an existing account restores previous pets automatically without losing data. (why: 8 emails (the top support issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Background Engine Render Time Estimator: Adds an active countdown timer and generation progress estimator bar on the waiting screen. (why: Median waiting time is 201 seconds with extreme tail mean times (2336s), causing uncertainty during asset generation.)
3: [finish, copy] Pet Desktop Visibility Quick Instructions: Updates home_intro text to explicitly guide users on using the system tray icon to show, hide, or recall their pet. (why: 3 support tickets complained about pets disappearing or missing from desktop after setup.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Engine Ready Tray Alert Prompt: Adds a desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes in the background. (why: Mean wait time on the waiting step reaches 2336 seconds, causing users to minimize the app and forget to return.)
